title: A FEM-Based Surrogate Modelling and Optimization Framework for Physics-Constrained Electromagnetic Coil Design
abstract: arXiv:2608.18903v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This work evaluates surrogate-assisted optimization of a seven-parameter current-excited coil--core benchmark subject to geometric, manufacturing, and separate core and copper mass constraints. A Python--MPh--COMSOL workflow couples a two-dimensional axisymmetric finite-element method (FEM) model to a Matern 5/2 Gaussian-process (GP) probabilistic surrogate. Here, physics-constrained denotes a design problem evaluated by a governing-equation FEM model and restricted by explicit physical, geometric, manufacturing, and material-allocation constraints; it does not denote a physics-informed GP architecture. Sequential Bayesian optimization (BO) ranks candidates using expected improvement (EI), and every reported incumbent is verified by FEM. Five paired runs show that optimizer ranking depends on the available FEM-evaluation budget: EI--BO improves rapidly at small continuation budgets, COBYLA is stronger at the earliest checkpoint, and BOBY

translated_title: 基于有限元法的物理约束电磁线圈设计代理建模与优化框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18903v1 公告类型：新  摘要：本研究评估了在几何、制造以及铁芯和铜质量分离约束下，对七参数电流激励线圈-铁芯基准问题进行代理辅助优化的效果。一个Python-MPh-COMSOL工作流程将二维轴对称有限元法（FEM）模型与Matern 5/2高斯过程（GP）概率代理模型相结合。这里，“物理约束”指的是由控制方程FEM模型评估的设计问题，并受显式物理、几何、制造和材料分配约束的限制；它并不指物理信息GP架构。顺序贝叶斯优化（BO）使用期望改进（EI）对候选方案进行排名，每个报告的当前最优解均由FEM验证。五次配对运行表明，优化器的排名取决于可用的FEM评估预算：在较小的连续预算下，EI-BO能快速改进；在最早检查点，COBYLA表现更强；而BOBY（截断）...
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合有限元模型与高斯过程代理的优化框架，在物理约束下实现了对电磁线圈设计的高效贝叶斯优化，并揭示了不同优化器在不同评估预算下的性能差异。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a surrogate-assisted optimization framework coupling FEM with Gaussian process for physics-constrained electromagnetic coil design, revealing optimizer performance varies with evaluation budget.
